# Cheat sheet

This page gathers the syntax used most often. Every snippet is written in English, as in the whole
book, and tested on Nim 2.2.12.

## Declarations

| Concept | Code |
|---|---|
| value that can change | `var count = 0` |
| assigned once | `let name = "Nim"` |
| known at compile time | `const MaxItems = 128` |
| explicit type | `var age: int8 = 24` |
| no initial value, holds the type default | `var flag: bool` |

## Primitive types and literals

| Concept | Code |
|---|---|
| integer | `let n = 42` |
| floating point | `let f = 3.14` |
| boolean | `let b = true` |
| character | `let c = 'x'` |
| text | `let s = "text"` |
| fixed-width integers | `int8`, `int16`, `int32`, `int64`, `int` |
| floating-point types | `float32`, `float64`, `float` |
| type alias | `type UserId = int` |
| hexadecimal, octal, binary | `0xFF`, `0o17`, `0b1010` |
| digit separator | `1_000_000` |
| conversion | `int(3.9)`, `float(2)`, `$42` |

## Strings and `&`

| Concept | Code |
|---|---|
| escape | `"line\n"`, `"tab\t"`, `"quote\""` |
| interpolation | `&"{name} has {count}"` |
| concatenation | `"a" & "b"` |
| index | `s[0]`, `s[^1]` |
| slice | `s[1 .. 3]`, `s[^3 .. ^1]` |
| one character, of type `char` | `s[0]` |
| length | `s.len` |

A raw string and a multiline string are written without escapes:

```nim
let raw = r"C:\temp"
let ml = """line one
line two"""
```

## `if`, `case`, `when`

```nim
let x = 3
if x > 0:
  echo "positive"
elif x == 0:
  echo "zero"
else:
  echo "negative"
```

```nim
case 0
of 0: echo "none"
of 1, 2: echo "few"
else: echo "many"
```

```nim
case 'a'
of 'a' .. 'z': echo "lower"
of '0' .. '9': echo "digit"
else: echo "other"
```

```nim
when defined(windows):
  echo "windows"
else:
  echo "other"
```

## Loops

| Concept | Code |
|---|---|
| inclusive range | `for i in 0 .. 3:` |
| exclusive range | `for i in 0 ..< 3:` |
| with a step | `for i in countup(0, 10, 2):` |
| downward | `for i in countdown(5, 1):` |
| values only | `for value in items:` |
| index and value | `for i, v in items:` |
| while | `while n > 0:` |
| stop, skip | `break`, `continue` |

## `array`, `seq`, and `openArray`

| Concept | Code |
|---|---|
| fixed-size array | `var a: array[3, int] = [1, 2, 3]` |
| array without an explicit type | `let a = [1, 2, 3]` |
| sequence | `let s = @[1, 2, 3]` |
| empty typed sequence | `var s: seq[int] = @[]` |
| append, remove | `s.add 4`, `s.delete(0)` |
| insert | `s.insert(1, 0)` |
| length | `s.len` |
| slice | `s[0 .. ^2]` |
| flexible parameter | `proc total(xs: openArray[int]): int` |

## Tuples and destructuring

| Concept | Code |
|---|---|
| named type | `type Point = tuple[x, y: int]` |
| value | `let p: Point = (x: 1, y: 2)` |
| field access | `p.x` |
| positional access | `p[0]` |
| unpack into variables | `let (a, b) = (1, 2)` |

## Objects and `ref object`

```nim
type
  Person = object
    name: string
    age: int

let p = Person(name: "Ada", age: 36)
echo p.name
```

```nim
type Node = ref object
  value: int
  next: Node

var n: Node
new(n)
n.value = 1
echo n.value
```

## Enums and sets

```nim
type Color = enum
  red, green, blue

echo ord(green)

var flags: set[Color] = {red, blue}
flags.incl green
flags.excl red
echo green in flags
```

## Procedures and parameters

| Concept | Code |
|---|---|
| return value | `proc add(a, b: int): int = a + b` |
| no side effects | `func square(x: int): int = x * x` |
| default parameter | `proc greet(name: string, punctuation = "!")` |
| named argument | `greet(punctuation = "?")` |
| overloading | `proc show(x: int)` and `proc show(x: string)` |
| `var` parameter | `proc double(x: var int) = x = x * 2` |

## Generics

```nim
proc largest[T](items: openArray[T]): T =
  result = items[0]
  for item in items:
    if item > result:
      result = item

echo largest([3, 9, 4])
```

| Concept | Code |
|---|---|
| generic type | `type Box[T] = object` |
| type constraint | `proc double[T: SomeNumber](x: T): T` |

## Templates

```nim
template twice(body: untyped) =
  body
  body

twice:
  echo "ping"
```

## Macros

```nim
import std/macros

macro triple(x: untyped): untyped =
  result = quote do:
    `x` * 3

echo triple(4)
```

## Exceptions and `raises`

```nim
try:
  raise newException(ValueError, "bad")
except ValueError as e:
  echo e.msg
finally:
  echo "done"
```

| Concept | Code |
|---|---|
| custom exception | `type TooLarge = object of CatchableError` |
| raise | `raise newException(TooLarge, "too large")` |
| `raises` effect | `proc risky(): int {.raises: [ValueError].}` |
| clean up on exit | `defer: echo "cleanup"` |

## Iterators

```nim
iterator evens(n: int): int =
  for i in 0 .. n:
    if i mod 2 == 0:
      yield i

for e in evens(6):
  echo e
```

## `import` and `export`

| Concept | Code |
|---|---|
| import a module | `import std/strutils` |
| several at once | `import std/[strutils, sequtils]` |
| partial import | `from std/math import sqrt` |
| alias | `import std/strutils as str` |
| use a qualifier | `str.strip(s)` |
| re-export | `export mymodule` |

## `strutils`, `sequtils`, `tables`, `json`

```nim
import std/[strutils, sequtils, tables, json]

echo "  Ada  ".strip.split(' ')
echo @[1, 2, 3].filterIt(it > 1).mapIt(it * 2)

var ages = initTable[string, int]()
ages["ada"] = 36
echo ages.getOrDefault("linus", 0)

let doc = """{"city": "Bandung"}""".parseJson
echo doc["city"].getStr
```

| Module | Frequently used functions |
|---|---|
| `strutils` | `strip`, `split`, `join`, `toUpperAscii`, `startsWith`, `replace`, `parseInt` |
| `sequtils` | `mapIt`, `filterIt`, `foldl` |
| `tables` | `initTable`, `hasKey`, `getOrDefault`, `t["k"]` |
| `json` | `parseJson`, `%*`, `getStr`, `getInt`, `pretty`, `to(Thing)` |

## `os`

| Concept | Code |
|---|---|
| environment variable | `getEnv("HOME", "/")`, `existsEnv("HOME")` |
| program arguments | `paramCount()`, `paramStr(1)`, `commandLineParams()` |
| directory | `getCurrentDir()`, `setCurrentDir(dir)` |
| file test | `fileExists(p)`, `dirExists(p)` |
| join a path | `"dir" / "file.txt"` |
| read, write | `readFile(p)`, `writeFile(p, s)` |
| walk | `walkDir(dir)`, `walkFiles("*.txt")` |

## `unittest`

```nim
import std/unittest

suite "add":
  test "two plus two":
    check 2 + 2 == 4
```

```nim
import std/[unittest, strutils]

expect ValueError:
  discard parseInt("x")
```

## `async`

```nim
import std/asyncdispatch

proc fetch(n: int): Future[int] {.async.} =
  return n * 2

proc main() {.async.} =
  let a = await fetch(3)
  let b = await fetch(4)
  echo a + b

waitFor main()
```

## FFI

```nim
{.compile: "helper.c".}

proc twice(x: cint): cint {.importc.}

echo twice(4)
```

```c
int twice(int x) { return x * 2; }
```

## The `nim` and `nimble` commands

| Command | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `nim c file.nim` | compile |
| `nim r file.nim` | compile and run |
| `nim check file.nim` | type check only |
| `nim c -d:release file.nim` | optimized build |
| `nim c -o:app file.nim` | set the binary name |
| `nim c --mm:orc file.nim` | pick the memory mode |
| `nim js file.nim` | compile to JavaScript |
| `nim doc file.nim` | build documentation |
| `nim c --hints:off file.nim` | silence hints |
| `nimble test` | run the tests |
| `nimble add pkg` | add a dependency |
| `nimble init` | create a project scaffold |
| `nimble build` | build the project |
| `nimble run` | build and run |
| `nimble install name` | install a package |

The contents of this page are tested on Nim 2.2.12. For longer explanations, each part has its own
chapter in this book.
